title: Emergency Response: Clear a Power Bus Fault

steps.hint: The POWER panel is straight ahead. Look at it until the gaze ring fills; a power bus feeds a group of systems.
Press ACK under the flashing CAUTION light on the POWER panel. Acknowledging confirms you have seen the alarm; it does not fix the fault.

steps.instruction: Open the CHECKLIST on the POWER FAULT display.
steps.hint: Select the CHECKLIST tab on the POWER FAULT display above the POWER panel. The checklist lists every step of the procedure, so nothing is missed.
Read the caption under the CAUTION light; it names the bus. Select the BUS B button, the one whose FAULT light is lit.
Turn the BUS B dial below the BUS B button until it points at ISOLATE. Isolating disconnects the bus so the fault cannot spread.
Move the CROSS-TIE lever on the right of the POWER panel to CLOSED. The cross-tie lets healthy BUS A feed BUS B.

steps.instruction: Press REPORT when the STATUS display shows RESTORED.
steps.hint: Check the STATUS display first; it should read RESTORED. Press REPORT below it to tell mission control the fault is cleared.
